+import os
+import json
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import secrets
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+
+import requests
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI")
+AUTH0_TOKEN_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token" if AUTH0_DOMAIN else None
+
+
+def build_pkce_verifier() -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode("utf-8").rstrip("=")
+
+
+def build_pkce_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("utf-8")).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode("utf-8").rstrip("=")
+
+
+def build_callback_response(code: str, state: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    if not AUTH0_TOKEN_URL:
+        raise ValueError("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
+    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise ValueError("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
+    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
+        raise ValueError("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET is required")
+    if not AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI:
+        raise ValueError("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI is required")
+
+    data = {
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "client_secret": AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET,
+        "code": code,
+        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+    }
+    if state:
+        data["state"] = state
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        AUTH0_TOKEN_URL,
+        data=data,
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    tokens = response.json()
+    return {
+        "provider": "auth0",
+        "token_endpoint": AUTH0_TOKEN_URL,
+        "tokens": tokens,
+    }
+
+
+def handle_oauth_callback(params: dict) -> str:
+    code = params.get("code")
+    if not code:
+        raise ValueError("Missing authorization code")
+    state = params.get("state")
+    result = build_callback_response(code, state)
+    return json.dumps(result)
+
+
+def callback_query_string(code: str, state: str | None = None) -> str:
+    payload = {"code": code}
+    if state:
+        payload["state"] = state
+    return urlencode(payload)
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import sys
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+
+
+def _b64url(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    client_id = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+    if not client_id:
+        print("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    domain = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+    if not domain:
+        print("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    redirect_uri = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback")
+    scope = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
+    verifier = _b64url(secrets.token_bytes(32))
+    challenge = _b64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
+
+    auth_url = "https://{}/authorize?{}".format(
+        domain,
+        urllib.parse.urlencode(
+            {
+                "response_type": "code",
+                "client_id": client_id,
+                "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+                "scope": scope,
+                "state": state,
+                "code_challenge": challenge,
+                "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+            }
+        ),
+    )
+
+    print(auth_url)
+    if os.environ.get("AUTH0_OPEN_BROWSER", "1") != "0":
+        webbrowser.open(auth_url)
+
+    print(state)
+    print(verifier)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
